description: Read the same saved report as Results in SmartGenius. Pass only a sourceId from list_report_sources, never a provider account id. The default is 7 complete days, or the latest reading for video counts. Use nextOffset for more detail rows. A missing number is unknown, not zero. Use the source's currency and time zone; never add totals across sources. This does not call the provider or spend credits.
name: get_report
title: Read a shared report
